seed: Object names may encode position or identity. Work out the naming rule from the data and derive renaming on move, birth and removal from it, so names are never looked up.

synth.notes:
Player moves in 3-cell steps on colours {1,4}; an overlapping block is kicked while the player stays.
Blocks slide in 1-cell chain ticks over {1,4,15}, stopping at walls, bounds, the player, or non-fitting sockets.
Click transfers control to a block and leaves a centre-4 husk; touching player sides render colour 0.
HUD consumes ceil(actions/2) cells; parity is retained only across exact frame continuity.
Names: blocks rank by (y,x), sockets use centre (y,x); names are unused for frames. Socket completion remains unconfirmed.
